summary: Small rectangular IMU carrier PCB with surface-mount components on top. It has one round mounting hole near a corner and a row of five 0.1 in-pitch pin pads along one short edge, plus an offset SA0 pad.

mountingSurfaces.description: Flat underside of the PCB, usable as the seating face. The bounding box is centered on the part, so the bottom face sits at z = -1.5 mm.

notes: X and Y come from the printed 0.8 in x 0.5 in outline (20.32 x 12.7 mm). The mounting hole diameter is the printed 0.086 in (2.18 mm). The hole position is estimated from the pixel layout of the drawing: about 2.1 mm from the left edge and 2.1 mm from the top edge, with the pin row on the +x side and +y toward SCL. The 3 mm height is the unverified catalog value and is not printed in the images, so it covers the board plus the tallest components. The five 2.54 mm-pitch pin holes along the +x edge (SCL, SDA, GND, VIN, VDD) and the SA0 hole are visible, but their diameters are not stated, so they are not listed in the holes array.
